title: Affine chart comparison certificate for a supplied projection mate
statement: Let X,Y be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X\to Y a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, and choose the derived module categories in common morphism universe w [def-pc-derived-category]. Let p:Lf^*\dashv Rf_* be any adjunction for [def-pc-derived-pullback] and [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let t be any invertible comparison Lf^*(-\otimes^L-)\simeq Lf^*(-)\otimes^L Lf^*(-) for [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For M\in D_{QCoh}(Y), L\in D_{QCoh}(X), let alpha be the transpose under p of t_{M,Rf_*L} followed by 1\otimes epsilon_L. For each affine open V\subseteq Y there exist a commutative ring A of universe u, a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme Z, a quasi-compact quasi-separated g:Z\to Spec(A), isomorphisms eV:Spec(A)\simeq V and eZ:Z\simeq f^{-1}(V) satisfying g;eV=eZ;(f|_V), and, in the standard derived localizations of morphism universe u+1, an adjunction q:Lg^*\dashv Rg_*, an invertible tensor-pullback comparison s, and N\in D_{QCoh}(Spec A), E\in D_{QCoh}(Z), such that invertibility of the affine mate pi_{q,s}(N,E) implies invertibility of H^n(alpha)|_V for every integer n. This statement assumes no projection-formula theorem on affine targets.

proof.text: Construct the geometric chart square using exists_projectionMate_affineChart_data. Eliminate its witnesses and install their ring and compactness/morphism instances. This theorem explicitly proves the section-ring/inverse-image-open construction from Mathlib.

Apply projectionMate_affineChart_transport to the supplied f,p,t,M,L and the fixed square. Eliminate q,s,N,E and their implication, then assemble the nested existential witnesses. This groups precisely the remaining derived steps 2--3, excluding all chart geometry.

theorem exists_projectionMate_affineChart_certificate
    (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (hA : CommRing A),
      letI := hA
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (hZ : CompactSpace Z) (hZqs : QuasiSeparatedSpace Z),
        letI := hZ
        letI := hZqs
        letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))
        letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
        ∃ (g : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (hg : QuasiCompact g) (hgqs : QuasiSeparated g),
          letI := hg
          letI := hgqs
          ∃ (eV : Spec (.of A) ≅ V.toScheme)
            (eZ : Z ≅ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme),
            g ≫ eV.hom = eZ.hom ≫ (f ∣_ V) ∧
          ∃ (q : derivedPullback g ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage g)
            (s : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
              (derivedPullback g).prod (derivedPullback g) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
            (N : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A))) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
            IsIso (q.homEquiv (N.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj)
              ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj ⊗ E.obj)
              (s.hom.app (N.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj) ≫
                (𝟙 ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj) ⊗ₘ q.counit.app E.obj))) →
            ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).map
              (p.homEquiv (M.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj)
              ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj ⊗ L.obj)
              (t.hom.app (M.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj) ≫
                (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L.obj)))).over V)
